objectives: 本課程旨在提供藝術史理論與方法之發展的宏觀視野，並且呈現近年的學術研究成果如何面對諸如檔案熱、關係美學、操演轉向、人類世、全球化，以及在地理論等新興課題的挑戰。於此同時，也期望藉由理論文本的拆解與研討，帶領年輕研究者們一同思索藝術史實踐在當代的諸多可能性。
content:
導論
1.	（09/13）課程簡介（內部性分析 I）
2.	（09/20）研究方法與寫作指引（內部性分析 II）

圖像、影像與媒介
3.	（09/27）
Robert S. Nelson and Richard Shiff (eds.), Critical Terms for Art History, (Chicago, IL: University of Chicago Press, 2010), pp. 3-19, 35-48. (Representation, Simulacrum)
4.	（10/04）
Hans Belting, An Anthropology of Images: Picture, Medium, Body, trans. Thomas Dunlap (Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 2022), Chapter 1, pp. 9-36.

性別研究、精神分析及酷兒理論
5.	（10/11）
Jonathan Harris, The New Art History: A Critical Introduction (London & New York: Routledge, 2001), Chapter 4, pp. 129-160.
6.	（10/18）
Amelia Jones, In between Subjects: A Critical Genealogy of Queer Performance (London, England: Routledge, 2020), Introduction, pp. 1-33.

檔案熱與檔案衝動
7.	（10/25）
Hal Foster, “An Archival Impulse,” October 110 (2004): 3–22.
8.	（11/01）
Okwui Enwezor, Archive Fever: Uses of the Document in Contemporary Art (Steidl/ICP; First Edition), pp. 11-51.

藝術史與關係生產
9.	（11/08）
Cindy Persinger and Azar Rejaie (eds.), Socially Engaged Art History and Beyond: Alternative Approaches to the Theory and Practice of Art History, 1st ed. (Cham, Switzerland: Springer Nature, 2022), Chapter 3, “What Is Socially Engaged Art History?” pp. 30-46.
10.	（11/15）
Claire Bishop, “Antagonism and Relational Aesthetics,” October 110 (2004): 51–79.

藝術史與操演轉向
11.	（11/22）
Cristina Baldacci, ‘Re-Presenting Art History: An Unfinished Pro-cess’, in Over and Over and Over Again: Reenactment Strategies in Contemporary Arts and Theory, ed. by Cristina Baldacci, Clio Nicastro, and Arianna Sforzini, Cultural Inquiry, 21 (Berlin: ICI Berlin Press, 2022), pp. 173–182.

Amelia Jones, “The Now and the Has Been: Paradoxes of Live Art in History,” in Adrian Heathfield and Amelia Jones (eds.), Perform, Repeat, Record: Live Art in History (London, England: Routledge, 2012), pp. 11-25.
12.	（11/29）
Claire Bishop, “Black Box, White Cube, Gray Zone: Dance Exhibitions and Audience Attention,” TDR/The Drama Review 62, no. 2 (2018): 22–42.

藝術史與人類世
13.	（12/06）
Andrew Patrizio, The Ecological Eye: Assembling an Ecocritical Art History (Manchester, England: Manchester University Press, 2018), Chapter 1, “The evolution of ecocritical art history,” pp. 29-44; Chapter 2, “Art history in an expanded field,” pp. 45-59.
14.	（12/13）
Scott Lash, “Objects that Judge Latour’s Parliament of Things,” in Another Modernity: A Different Rationality (London, England: Blackwell, 1999), pp. 312-338.

Bruno Latour, We Have Never Been Modern, trans. Catherine Porter (London, England: Harvard University Press, 1993), Chapter 5, pp. 130-145.

藝術史與全球化∕在地化
15.	（12/20）
James Elkins (ed.), Is Art History Global? (London, England: Routledge, 2013), Introduction, “Art History as a Global Discipline,” pp. 3-23.
16.	（12/27）
James Elkins (ed.), Is Art History Global? (London, England: Routledge, 2013), Afterword, “Globalizing Art History,” pp. 405-440.

期末呈現
17.	（01/03）期末口頭報告與綜合討論
18.	（01/10）期末報告繳交
books:
基本參考書
Charles Harrison, Paul Wood, and Jason Gaiger (eds.), Art in Theory 1900-2000: An Anthology of Changing Ideas, 2nd ed. (London, England: Blackwell, 2002).
Charles Merewether and John Potts (eds.), After the Event: New Perspectives on Art History (Manchester, England: Manchester University Press, 2010).
Dana Arnold (ed.), Art History: Contemporary Perspectives on Method (Chichester, England: Wiley-Blackwell, 2010).
Grant Pooke and Diana Newall, Art History: The Basics (London & New York: Routledge, 2008).
Matthew Rampley, Exploring Visual Culture: Definitions, Concepts, Contexts (Edinburgh: Edinburgh University Press, 2005).
Michael Hatt and Charlotte Klonk, Art History: A Critical Introduction to Its Methods (Manchester: Manchester University Press, 2006).
Richard Shiff and Robert Nelson (eds.), Critical Terms for Art History (second edition; Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 2003).
Richard Shone and John-Paul Stonard (eds.), The Books that Shaped Art History: From Gombrich and Greenberg to Alpers and Krauss (Thames & Hudson, 2013).

觀看實踐與圖像研究
Ken Wilder, Beholding: Situated Art and the Aesthetics of Reception (London, England: Bloomsbury Visual Arts, 2020).
W. J. T. Mitchell, What Do Pictures Want?: The Lives and Loves of Images (Chicago, IL: University of Chicago Press, 2006).
__________, Image Science: Iconology, Visual Culture, and Media Aesthetics (Chicago, IL: University of Chicago Press, 2018).
Jonathan Crary, Techniques of the Observer: On Vision and Modernity in the Nineteenth Century (London, England: MIT Press, 1992). 中譯本：強納森‧柯拉瑞著，蔡佩君、王嘉驥譯，《觀察者的技術：論十九世紀的視覺與現代性》。臺北：行人出版社，2007。

視覺文化研究
Margaret Dikovitskaya, Visual Culture: The Study of the Visual after the Cultural Turn (London, England: MIT Press, 2006).
Nicholas Mirzoeff, An Introduction to Visual Culture (London, England: Routledge, 1999).
王正華，〈藝術史與文化史的交界：關於視覺文化研究〉，《近代中國史研究通訊》，32期，2001年9月，頁76-89。

檔案轉向
Charles Merewether, The Archive (London, England: Whitechapel Gallery, 2006).
Deceased Jacques Derrida, Archive Fever: A Freudian Impression, trans. Eric Prenowitz (Chicago, IL: University of Chicago Press, 2017).
Sven Spieker, The Big Archive: Art from Bureaucracy (London, England: MIT Press, 2017).

藝術史與博物館
Douglas Crimp, On The Museum’s Ruins (London, England: MIT Press, 1995).
David Carrier, Museum Skepticism (Durham, NC: Duke University Press, 2009).
Iain Chambers et al., The Postcolonial Museum: The Arts of Memory and the Pressures of History (Boca Raton, FL: CRC Press, 2017).

科技藝術與新媒體研究
Anna Bentkowska-Kafel, Trish Cashen, and Hazel Gardiner (eds.), Digital Art History: A Subject in Transition. Computers and the History of Art Series, Volume 1, (Intellect, 2005).
Jay David Bolter and Richard A. Grusin, Remediation: Understanding New Media (London, England: MIT Press, 2000).
Kathryn Brown (ed.), The Routledge Companion to Digital Humanities and Art History (London, England: Routledge, 2022).
Steve Dixon, A Digital Performance: History of New Media in Theater, Dance, Performance Art, and Installation (Mit Press, 2007).
